My teaching experience includes laboratory and teaching-assistant activities in machine learning, signal processing, deep learning, computer vision, and biomedical signal and image processing.

{{< include ../_includes/generated/courses.md >}}

## Additional teaching experience

At Sharif University of Technology, I served as a teaching assistant in courses including **Deep Learning**, **Computer Vision**, **Tensor Decompositions in Signal Processing**, **EEG Signal Processing**, **Medical Image Processing**, **Medical Image Systems**, and the **Biomedical Signal and Image Processing Laboratory**.

At Télécom Paris, my teaching and laboratory activities have included source separation, non-negative matrix factorization, introductory and statistical machine learning, and graph machine learning labs.
